title: PDF overlay fills the Live Media panel
description:
View PDF now stretches to the full height of the Live Media panel instead of sitting in a short strip at the top. Exit still returns to the video.

Who is affected: PipeShare users opening report PDFs on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Pipe-chart PDF overlay fills the media panel height.
Fixed CSS conflict that capped the PDF iframe to a short strip.
